content:
The iPhone Duo's unique design has led Apple to adjust iOS 27 in several ways to fully realize the potential of this new device. These include placing the iPhone Dock on the right side of the outer screen rather than at the bottom of the display.

Developer pdfu has now discovered another iPhone Duo-exclusive feature that offers a more convenient way to toggle Focus modes...

The most obvious software change accompanying the new hardware is, of course, that when you open the iPhone Duo, the outer screen loses focus and becomes nearly transparent. However, moving the Dock to the right side of the outer screen is another distinct and quite noticeable difference exclusive to this device.

Developer pdfu has been finding and showcasing numerous new features within the iPhone Duo simulator, and has now discovered yet another. On the iPhone Duo's lock screen, above the camera and flashlight icons, a new Focus mode toggle button has been added.

It appears this feature will only appear when a Focus mode is enabled, allowing you to turn it off directly from the lock screen. However, after turning it off, you can reactivate the same mode again. For example, if you want to turn off Do Not Disturb mode after a meeting, there's no need to unlock or open the phone — this design makes a lot of sense.

This leaker has also revealed several unannounced new features, including StandBy views for the iPhone Duo and HomePad, as well as color options for the HomePad.
